strings.en: I won't let anyone get in my way!
If you're going to repent, do it now!!
You there, it's too late for regrets!
You there, let's have a fair fight!
I'll hit you, no matter what!
I know the Boxer's quirks inside and out!
Take the power of the Exbein Boxer!
I'm used to handling the Gunner!
We can't have you people doing business here!
Now that you've met us, your business is finished!
I'll teach you that the Earth Sphere/　isn't a profitable place!
I'll teach you what karma means!
I'm not about to play along with your fun!
I won't let a man like you get away with it!
I won't forgive the way you do things!
Don't think you'll win any glory here!
My sense of justice won't lose to mere obsession!
Jua-Mu, I'll purge you of your sins!
Against Al-Van, I have to go all out...!
Raftclans or not, I'm fighting fair and square!
I won't back down, even against a Raftclans,/　Fu-Ruu!
A woman-to-woman showdown! I won't lose!
So you'll keep fighting under Gu-Landon...!
Whatever power the Emperor Unit has...!
Gu-Landon!/　A king steeped in ambition has only one fate!
We have to reach Rabulpaila, no matter what!
We can't back down here either!
Answer Fairy's feelings, why don't you!
Reggiane, you're the one who's going to bleed!
I can't believe you'd use something like the Cross Gate!
Pay for the strife you've brought upon two worlds!
Remnants of the Dark Brain? No way!
Both the name and the look are a joke!
What do you plan to do with the fused Lamaris?!
I won't allow your evil schemes!
I have to stop those units moving...!
I'm destroying Zovorg units either way!
Even the Yokijin are being controlled...!
Wicked dragons always get slain. That's a given!
I won't leave evil alone!/　Prepare yourself, Skull Knight!
Evil can only perish, Skull Knight!
First a dragon and a clown, now a skeleton?!
XN-L!/　Whatever your origins, right now you're just evil!
I'll beat down your twisted justice.../　No, I'll smash it to pieces!
I'm used to fighting these, but I won't get careless!
A high-performance production model.../　I'll shoot it down!
A Zeidram... I'd better be cautious with my attack!
It's a new model. No careless moves.
I need to gather data and analyze it later.
If you're attacking, I won't hold back, Fury!
I won't let you Fury units have your way!
So that's the one leading the new models...!
I have no choice but to retreat...!
It's huge, but it moves fast... Even so!
Where on earth did something like that come from...!
It's not just its looks that are creepy...!
All right, time to slay a monster!
We have to wipe out every last Lamaris...!
I won't leave a single one, Lamaris!
I'm not going to get creeped out!
I'm showing no mercy to monsters!
Now that they've combined,/　they're even more sinister...
I won't be cowed by your looks or your size!
Lamaris Kaana! Vanish here and now!
I have to watch out for those tentacles!
If more of those things appear...!
A colossal negative presence.../　If that showed up in a city...!
We have to destroy the Lamaris Ida right away!
Why are the Ares Geist and the Lamaris...?!
All we can do now is bet on Arieil...!
We can't let the Dark Brain be revived!
I can't leave the Yokijin be!
This is where I turn things around!
From here on, it's a battle of Spirit!
I won't just sit here and take it!
I won't lose to you in Spirit!
Don't underestimate me just 'cause I'm a girl!
Attack me, and I won't just stay quiet!
That really fired up my spirit...! Prepare yourself!
Kyaaah!/　I can't go down in a place like this!!
I can't believe I lost here!
Ugh!/　Like I'd ever let myself lose!!
Ngh! I can't let myself/　hold everyone back now!
I-I can't believe I took/　this much damage...!!
I'm hit!?/　But I'm not running away!!
N-Not yet...!/　I'll pull through no matter what!
Kyaah!/　I won't go down in a place like this!!
Aah!/　My armor, broken through so easily...!?
Ugh...!/　The Grungust isn't going down yet!
The AM Gunner is badly damaged...!
Herluga's drowning in that power...!/　That's where the opening will be!
Kyaah! Against someone treating this like a game...!
Ugh! I have to give it my all here.../　I just have to!!
Ow!/　Y-You're pretty good, aren't you!
Don't get the wrong idea/　that this is all I've got!
Ngh! I'm never going to lose to you!
Ngh! It reached farther than I expected!
I-I'll remember you... count on it!
I-I managed to hold out, but...!
I'm not backing down/　over something like this!
It'll take more than this/　to make me whine!
Ugh... Guess I've still got/　a lot to learn...
That's the Grungust for you./　It's still fine.
At this rate, I can't draw out/　the Gespenst's full power...!
Ugh, can't I handle the Boxer fully...?!
Tch, to think it caught the Gunner!
I'm not about to play your games!
Everything you say and do.../　I'll never accept it!
Ugh...! I'm not fighting/　to entertain you...!
Jua-Mu,/　don't think this is enough to cow me!
So you're finally getting serious, Al-Van...!
I can't keep up with the Raftclans...!
Gu-Landon.../　Do you mean to twist everything like this...?!
Vort! This fight isn't over yet!
It's not for nothing that you serve Herluga...!
So this is just what Herluga wants...?!
To get hit by such a ridiculous guy!
You live up to calling yourself the strongest...!
I-I have to stop XN-L here...!
I can't lose to the Fury...!
I need to put distance between me and the unknowns...!
As if I'd lose to the Lamaris!
The Ares Geist's strikes/　are even sharper...!
So that Yokijin isn't just for show...!
Is that all?/　Still, I won't let my guard down!
To think I got hit.../　I'll take this as a lesson!
You need to take this more seriously!
Oh no!/　I couldn't dodge it...!
If you don't put some Spirit into it,/　you'll regret it!
Ugh...!/　That one was my mistake...!
I have to reflect on this/　and do better next time...!
I won't lose to skills like that!
No good, my evasive maneuver wasn't perfect.
This is nothing for a Grungust.
I thought I was used to handling it...!
The Boxer can take this much!
Even the Gunner couldn't dodge it all!
I'm not having any fun here!
Al-Van, you don't need to hold back!
I'll withstand even the Emperor Unit's attacks!
Ugh... Looks like you can back up your big talk.
Herluga, I won't bow to you!
I'm taking this seriously, you know!
I have to dodge cleanly, or I can't beat XN-L!
That's the best a Zovorg unit can do, huh.
So you're aiming for me. Come at me all you want!
I won't be beaten by the Fury!
I couldn't keep up with the Thorn...!
I couldn't shake off the Lamaris...!
It got bigger, and its power went up too...!
The Ares Geist... It's faster than before.
There's no point if I'm the one who gets slain!
Ngh! A Yokijin latched on to me!
Oh my, your aim is a little off.
Don't think I'll be an easy opponent!
I can't afford to get hit!
I'll dodge it with sheer Spirit!
You underestimated the Exbein Boxer's moves!
Piloting the Gunner is my specialty!
Not by someone as ridiculous as you!
No matter how amazing the attack, if I dodge it right...!
I won't get dragged into your pace!
The Cross Gate doesn't belong to you!
As if I'd let you possess this unit!
Let's see how long you can keep up/　that ridiculous attitude!
To protect the Earth Sphere, I can't get hit!
Looks like you can't use that commander unit's power!
Performance alone doesn't decide who wins!
Having data is useless/　if you can't apply it!
Aim at me, not those two units!
Gadisword units aren't so tough after all.
Is that all, just flitting around?
I'll wipe you out soon, so just wait!
Lamaris Kaana, I won't let you...!
So you got bigger. So what?!
Even the Ares Geist, if I can deflect it...!
It missed!?/　Still, I won't let my guard down!
Stay alert, the next one's coming!
That was a little close, huh?
At this rate, even I can hold them off.
I don't want to think that was a close call, but...
Shall I fire up your spirit for you?
Against a Grungust, I probably/　didn't even need to dodge.
No need to hold back, Al-Van!
Foul play won't break the righteous path, Karo-Ran!
As if you could build a world/　on twisted belief and power!
Your justice doesn't work on me!
How long can you keep that cool face?
To think they'd use a trick like that...
I managed to dodge the Thorn's strike...!
I won't lose to an attack like that!
I can't let every shot hit me!
It missed!? Thanks to the Jammer!
Oh no...! That was my mistake...
Isn't there any weapon I can use!?
Ugh.../　They've figured out my range...!
Come in closer, why don't you!
I can still attack from here!
You'll have to deal with me too!
Ryoto, don't let your guard down!
So I take it from here... right, Ryoto!
Not yet, Kusuha! Here's mine too!
Kusuha, fall back! I'll handle the rest!
Tasuku, you didn't finish the job!
Yuuki, leave the rest to me!
Raul, I'll take it from here!
Lieutenant Kyosuke, I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Excellen,/　leave the rest to me!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Michiru, you can't just charge in!
Rio here! Captain, I'll back you up!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I can't let you get away!
I'll save them, no matter what!
I can't just leave things like this!
Ryoto, leave the defense to me!
Kusuha! Get out of here, quick!
Radha, get away while you can!
Lieutenant, I'll buy you some time!
Carla! You've got to stay focused!
Arado! Don't trust your armor too much!
Kota, I told you not to look away!
Aqua, get out of here, quick!
Let's hit them all at once!!
I'll show you the Armorlion's finisher!
This motion pattern was made by Ryoto!
All at once! Let's go, Bilgern!
At this speed, I can't lose!
Go ahead, run if you think you can!
Hiding won't do you any good!
I'm using a MAP weapon!/　All allies, fall back!
One shot won't be the end of it!!
Take that, and that, and that!!
The sword that cuts down evil, its name is...!
This is Type-1 Kai's ultimate technique...!
I'll show you the G-Raptor and/　G-Bison combination!
It almost feels like a waste/　to fire these, but...!
A strike from the heavens! Take this!!
No enemy can stand before me and the Exbein!
Take that, and that, and that!
I'll use the Type-Haken's special move!
There's a lot of competition, China girl.
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
I'll show you Type 2's ultimate technique!
I'll show you the Pfeil III's ultimate special move!
Take that, and that, and that!
A combo mixing close and long range!
These twin swords are quite sharp!
I'm not gonna miss, no way!
I'll show you the Varga's special move!
I'm pretty confident in my shooting, you know!
